sentences.en: The last minute of the championship soccer game felt eternal because of the high stakes.

sentences.en: His championship of the rights of the laity and his belief in the autonomy of the church led him to advocate the separation of church and state.

sentences.en: Every October the island hosts a world championship windsurfing event.

sentences.en: It boasted two championship mini-golf courses, go-karting and batting cages.

sentences.en: The right to the championship was disputed with the Dymoke family by Sir Baldwin de Freville, lord of Tamworth, who was descended from an elder daughter of Philip Marmion.

sentences.en: Preston won the Second Division championship the next season losing only seven matches in the League.
